title: Tool servers started with an unpinned or @latest package and no check that the tool descriptions are the ones a person approved

planted.why: the servers are fetched by name, one as @latest and one with no version, so a new release replaces the code and tool descriptions a person reviewed on 2026-09-20
the client offers whatever tools the server lists today with no comparison to what was approved, so a changed description or new tool is trusted at once

proof.python:
import json
cfg = json.load(open('mcp.json'))
args = [a for s in cfg['servers'].values() for a in s['args'] if a.startswith('@acme')]
assert all('@' not in a[1:] or a.endswith('@latest') for a in args) and any(a.endswith('@latest') for a in args)
s = open('client.py').read()
assert 'hash' not in s and 'lock' not in s
